title: News 10.06.2026
content: Three Broad researchers honored by NIH’s High-Risk, High-Reward Program Erin Chen and Sam Peng receive the NIH Director's New Innovator Award for innovative, early-career investigators; JT Neal receives the NIH Director's Transformative Research Award for bold, groundbreaking research. By Broad Communications October 6, 2026 Erin Chen, Sam Peng, and JT Neal (left to right).
